newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla fed cattle turn active late $65-USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla fed cattle turn active late $65-USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow early, active afternoon in the Panhandle area Friday, USDA said.

Slaughter steers and heifers steady. Feedlots reporting good inquiry from buyers. Sales reported on 15,500 slaughter steers and 9,600 heifers; 25,100 head confirmed for the week to date. Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink. Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1250 lbs 65.00.
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1150 lbs 65.00.
